title: S(3;4,5,11) = 153
statement: The generalized off-diagonal Schur number S(3;4,5,11) is exactly 153: every 3-colouring of {1,...,153} contains x_1+...+x_{3}=x_4 monochromatic in colour 1, or x_1+...+x_{4}=x_5 monochromatic in colour 2, or x_1+...+x_{10}=x_11 monochromatic in colour 3; and some 3-colouring of {1,...,152} avoids all three.

concept_refs.note: graph/concepts/schur-number.md, authored for this family and committed to math-education as ce3e2a5 The node's body carries this family's central soundness warning -- that when colours forbid DIFFERENT equations they are not interchangeable, and a search assuming otherwise reports no colouring exists when one does.
the additive-Ramsey case; off-diagonal is the analogue of asymmetric Ramsey numbers

provenance.conjectured_by: Ahmed-Schaal Conjecture 2 predicts S(3;s,t,u) = s*t*u - t*u - u - 1 for 4 <= s <= t <= u. This value, 153, AGREES with it. The conjecture is open; arXiv:2604.11030 (Song and Mao, April 2026) proves the companion Conjecture 1 but not this one.

Produced by axeyum's own proof-producing CDCL core (solve_with_drat_proof_streaming, ADR-0381) streaming TEXT DRAT to disk and re-derived in the same process by axeyum's own backward DRAT checker (check_drat_backward, ADR-0382). No external solver and no external checker took part. The deciding CNF is the SUBSUMPTION-MINIMAL encoding: for solution sets S subset of S', clause(S) implies clause(S'), so only the minimal antichain is emitted -- a SUBSET of the full clause list, so refuting it refutes the full instance. check-claim-certificates.py validates the stored CNF clause by clause rather than by byte-identity, which is the check the bound actually needs. The deciding CNF is NOT stored beside this claim (not generated in this campaign); there is therefore no instance-pin row, and check-claim-certificates.py reports this row as NOT re-checked here rather than passing it. Regenerate with: cargo run --release -p axeyum-search --example offdiag_frontier -- bundle 4 5 11 153 <dir>

notes: NEW VALUE. NEW VALUE: not among Ahmed-Schaal's eleven exact values and not in Song-Mao arXiv:2604.11030 Table 3. The lower bound was a theorem; the upper bound is established here. Generated by crates/axeyum-search/src/offdiag.rs entry point OffDiagonalSchur::minimal_problem. Both sides are discharged -- n = N-1 satisfiable with an independently replayed colouring, n = N refuted with a DRAT proof re-derived by axeyum's own checker. SOUNDNESS NOTE: colours here are NOT interchangeable (each forbids a different equation), so the usual whole-palette symmetry breaking is UNSOUND and would produce a wrong unsat. The encoding orders colour classes only within blocks of colours carrying the SAME equation, and crates/axeyum-search/tests/offdiag_schur.rs carries a negative control showing the unblocked version turning satisfiable S(3;3,4,5) at n=41 into unsat.
